name: Jashobeam
title: David's Mightiest Warrior
summary: Jashobeam was the leader of David's three mightiest warriors, known as 'The Three'. He was a Hakmonite who distinguished himself by killing 300 (according to Chronicles) or 800 (according to Samuel) enemies with his spear in a single battle. He was one of the most prominent and brave warriors in King David's army.

keyEvents.title: Leader of the Three Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: Jashobeam was the foremost of David's three mightiest warriors and was recognized as the highest among them for his bravery and skill in battle.

keyEvents.title: Killed 300 Enemies in One Battle
keyEvents.description: Jashobeam swung his spear against 300 men and killed them in a single battle, an feat that made him legendary among David's men.

keyEvents.title: Killed 800 enemies according to the book of Samuel
keyEvents.description: In the parallel account in 2 Samuel, it is mentioned that he killed 800 men in one battle, highlighting his exceptional warrior skill.

keyEvents.title: Served as commander of the first division
keyEvents.description: Jashobeam, son of Zabdiel, was responsible for the first military division serving in the first month, with 24,000 men under his command.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's elite group
keyEvents.description: Together with Eleazar and Shammah, Jashobeam formed the inner circle of David's most trusted and brave warriors, who performed heroic feats for the kingdom of Israel.
